page_transcriptions.text:
TUITION FEE: Partner Universities: FREE. Non-partner universities: Based on registered courses.
ADMINISTRATION FEE: $70, to be submitted after students arrive at TUAF.
VISA FEE: $95.00/6 Months (1 semester); $135.00/12 Months (2 semester).
INSURANCE FEE: Students should purchase travel insurance in their home country.
ESTIMATED COST OF LIVING: Accommodation: $10 (Dormitory). Food: $90-110/month ($1-1.3/meal). Bills (Electricity, water, cleaning, etc.): $7-15/month.
